description: HELECAR-D records a Renault Twizy driven along three urban and ring-road routes in Rabat–Salé–Kénitra, Morocco, during March–July 2021. The International University of Rabat and UTBM collaborators collected vehicle CAN-bus signals and GPS positions, supplemented with weather, traffic and speed-limit context. GitHub lists seventeen processed CSV journeys and their raw counterparts. Processed vehicle values use one-second steps; weather is acquired less frequently. The data include speed, battery state of charge, driving mode and position, with message identifiers and hexadecimal payloads retained in the raw files. GitHub explicitly licenses the dataset under CC BY 4.0; its Zenodo archive uses the broader Other Open label. Access is free. Coverage is limited to one vehicle and three routes, and processing replaces missing or incorrect values with previous readings. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating electric-vehicle demand or driving-cycle assumptions in transport simulations. model-sumo is a related traffic simulator, but no conversion or calibration was attempted.
